Source: MF podatki.gov.pl - objaśnienia i przepisy podatkowe
URL: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/interpretacje-podatkowe/

Summary:
- The page is theTax Servicе “Interpretacje podatkowe” on podatki.gov.pl, a central portal for Polish tax interpretations and guidance.
- It provides categorized sections for personal taxes, business taxes, customs, guides/informational materials, news, tools, and online services.
- Key sections include: Od dochodu (income taxes), Od majątku (property/estate taxes like inheritance and donation), Od zakupów (purchase-related taxes), and various specific tax topics for entrepreneurs (basic taxes, PCC, SD, VAT-related items, withholding/tax schemes such as WHT, MDR, ICAP, etc.).
- It also lists compliance and regulatory resources such as Klauzula ogólna przeciwko unikaniu opodatkowania, Rejestr działalności, and other cross-border and international tax frameworks.
- There are dedicated options to manage tax matters online ("Załatw sprawę online") and to access tools, news, and i...
